prompt:
Create a transparent game sprite sheet with FOUR equal square cells side by side in ONE ROW, aspect ratio 4:1, ideally 2048x512. Four views of the supplied rubber stamp designs. Use all four references with distinct roles:
Reference1 = exact approval stamp design and colors (teal-green rounded rectangular base, cream rubber band near bottom, golden yellow sculpted bulb handle and collar, white check on front).
Reference2 = exact rejection stamp, identical form but coral-red base and white X on front.
Reference3 = CAMERA VIEW ONLY: high overhead perspective matching desk, looking downward at roughly 60 degrees from horizontal. Do not draw the desk.
Reference4 = Midi robot hand and forearm design ONLY: glossy white and light-blue rounded arm shells, rounded mitten hand, small rounded blue fingertips, medium-blue contour lines. No full robot, no writing.

CAMERA CRITICAL: All four cells share precisely the SAME high-angle 60-degree downward view, much higher than the stamp reference photos. The broad TOP plane of each rectangular stamp base dominates, its shallow front face is only a small strip. The circular rounded TOP of the yellow handle is clearly visible as a broad near-round ellipse. Shorten the handle's projected vertical length for this high camera elevation. Do not reuse the low eye-level perspective of reference1/2. Upright stamps, not tilted stamps. Same lighting and glossy storybook shading across all cells.

LAYOUT/REGISTRATION: each cell 512x512. Stamp base centered horizontally within each cell; same base bounding box approximately x=100..412, y=210..400 relative to cell. Handle rises toward about y=85. Keep identical local stamp position, size, rotation and camera perspective across all four cells. Cells3 and4 are overlay states of cells1 and2: exact same stamp under an added hand/arm. The hand must NOT move, enlarge, tilt or shift the stamp. Entire sheet readable with clear cell spacing. No cell lines.

CELL1: green/teal check stamp alone, standing upright, exact original color/design reprojected to high-angle desk view.
CELL2: red/coral X stamp alone, same geometry, yellow handle and cream bottom stripe, same high-angle view.
CELL3: IDENTICAL green/teal check stamp at exactly cell1 local coordinates and size, now held by Midi's round robot mitten. White and pale-blue palm wraps around the yellow bulb handle from ABOVE, small rounded blue fingertips curl around the far side of the grip. Leave some golden yellow handle top visible beside fingers so grip is readable. Short rounded white/light-blue forearm approaches from BOTTOM CENTER of this cell and is cropped by its BOTTOM EDGE. Anatomically coherent robot grasp, no human hand, no skin. Hand occludes only necessary stamp portions; the visible base retains original registration.
CELL4: IDENTICAL red/coral X stamp at exactly cell2 local coordinates and size, held with EXACT SAME Midi hand pose and bottom-entering arm as cell3.

Transparent background throughout. No desk, no floor, no ground shadow, no drop shadow, no halo or glow. Only stamp symbols check and X; no text, letters, numbers, AI or logos. Preserve cream band and original teal/coral/yellow design. Clean outlined glossy storybook game art, smoothly rounded Midi hand with small blue fingertips and medium-blue hand/arm outlines. Four equal square cells in one horizontal row.
